label: Lemon Squeezy
terms_note: Automation allowed with a store API key; MoR, 5 % + 50¢; rate limits not published; the public feature request for product create/update (nolt #279) is still open

sandbox.notes: Lemon Squeezy test mode is a key, not a host: 'API keys can be created in both live and test modes' and every request goes to https://api.lemonsqueezy.com. Put a test-mode API key in PLATFORM_MCP_LEMON_SQUEEZY_API_KEY; records created in test mode carry test_mode: true.

fields.name: api_key
fields.help: Lemon Squeezy API key (Settings > API > create key; 'Generated API keys are valid for a year'), sent as 'Authorization: Bearer {api_key}'. Test-mode keys only see test-mode data (https://docs.lemonsqueezy.com/api/getting-started/requests).

config_fields.name: store_id
config_fields.help: Numeric store id (GET /v1/stores). Filters list_products / list_sales with filter[store_id] and is required by get_sales_stats.

adapter.terms: Lemon Squeezy is the merchant of record; JSON:API requests (Accept / Content-Type application/vnd.api+json).

me.note: GET /v1/users/me returns the key's user {data: {type: users, id, attributes: {name, email, color, avatar_url, ...}}}.

list_products.note: GET /v1/products?page[number]&page[size] (max 100) [&filter[store_id]=config store_id]. `price` is an INTEGER in cents of the store currency (999 = 9.99; price_formatted in raw); status is draft or published; `status` input is not a documented filter and is not sent; currency is not on the product (see the store).

get_product.note: GET /v1/products/:id; `price` is an integer in cents (see list_products).

list_sales.note: GET /v1/orders (newest first) [&filter[store_id]]. `amount` is total as an INTEGER in cents of `currency` (total_usd, refunded_amount and *_formatted in raw); status is pending, failed, paid, refunded, partial_refund or fraudulent. `product_id` and `since` are not sent (not documented order filters) - filter the rows by created_at / product_id yourself.

get_sales_stats.note: Store totals from GET /v1/stores/{config store_id}: revenue = total_revenue ('A positive integer in cents representing the total all-time revenue of the store in USD'), sales = total_sales (all-time count), plus thirty_day_revenue / thirty_day_sales. The API has no date-range report, so since / until / product_id are ignored and period is 'all_time'; refunds are not reported.

refund.note: MOVES MONEY - DESTRUCTIVE: POST /v1/orders/:id/refund issues a FULL refund when `amount` is omitted, otherwise a partial refund of `amount` as an INTEGER in cents of the order currency (100 = 1.00; a non-integer amount is rejected before sending). `reason` is not accepted. Returns the order with updated refunded / refunded_amount.

not_offered.create_product: Products are created in the dashboard; the API reference lists only The product object, Retrieve a product and List all products (https://docs.lemonsqueezy.com/api/products/the-product-object).
not_offered.update_price: Prices live on variants / price objects, which the API exposes read-only (Retrieve / List only: https://docs.lemonsqueezy.com/api/variants/the-variant-object, https://docs.lemonsqueezy.com/api/prices/the-price-object).
not_offered.list_refunds: There is no refunds resource; refunds are the refunded / refunded_amount / refunded_at attributes and status refunded or partial_refund on orders (https://docs.lemonsqueezy.com/api/orders/the-order-object) - use list_sales.

evidence: host api.lemonsqueezy.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (Google Trust Services)
probe: 6/6 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 2/2 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; every parameter and body key named on the page
